name: Parecoxib
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.dose: 40 mg IV or IM, then 20 or 40 mg every 6 to 12 hours as needed; maximum 80 mg/day

usual_adult_dose.indication: Older adults under 50 kg; moderate hepatic impairment (Child-Pugh 7–9)
usual_adult_dose.dose: Start at half the usual dose; maximum 40 mg/day

serious: Myocardial infarction; cardiovascular and thromboembolic events after coronary bypass surgery
Stevens-Johnson syndrome, toxic epidermal necrolysis, DRESS

contraindications: Pain after coronary artery bypass grafting
Heart failure (NYHA II–IV); established ischemic heart, peripheral arterial or cerebrovascular disease
Active peptic ulcer or gastrointestinal bleeding; inflammatory bowel disease
Severe hepatic impairment (albumin <25 g/L or Child-Pugh 10 or more)
Sulfonamide hypersensitivity; prior serious skin reaction
Aspirin- or NSAID-induced bronchospasm, urticaria or angioedema

pk.half_life: Parecoxib about 22 minutes; valdecoxib about 8 hours
pk.half_life_eskd: Valdecoxib clearance unchanged in severe impairment and dialysis
pk.metabolism: Parecoxib hydrolyzed in the liver to valdecoxib; valdecoxib by CYP3A4, CYP2C9 and glucuronidation
pk.excretion_renal_pct: About 70% in urine as inactive metabolites; under 5% unchanged valdecoxib
